title: 云依助手 0.13.9
releaseNotes: Combines packet authoring and saved libraries into the Network Debugger with one TCP client/server/UDP workspace. Preserves existing local packet data, multi-client server controls, line endings, continuous sending and multicast. Adds finite repeat batches, binary file loading and escaped bytes without a duplicate tool entry. Keeps a large side-by-side traffic console and separate stop-sending/disconnect actions. Validated old library compatibility, late traffic history, disconnected-client protection, multicast port reuse and responsive layouts with synthetic tests.
